title: 串联：只有一条路
summary: 两个电阻首尾相接：电流只有一条路可走，电压被它们分掉。
description: 串联就是元件首尾相接、只有一条电流路径：每个元件的电流相同，总电阻是各电阻之和，电源电压按电阻的比例分到各个元件上。电路：9 V → R1（220 Ω）→ R2（220 Ω）→ 红色 LED → GND。

cards.title: 先猜：电流会变大还是变小？
text: 先只放电源和两个电阻，**首尾相接**。
猜一下：和只用一个 220 Ω 相比，两个串起来以后，LED 的电流会变大、变小，还是不变？把你的猜测记在心里。

cards.title: 一条路，同一个电流
text: - **串联 = 只有一条路。** 电流从 + 出发，必须依次穿过 R1、R2、LED，没有岔路，所以**流过每个元件的电流都一样**。
- 电阻串联，总电阻**相加**：$R_{eq} = R_1 + R_2$。路越长越难走，电流变小。
- 电压按电阻的比例**分**掉：两个一样的电阻，各分到一样多。所有元件的电压加起来正好等于电源电压——这就是 **KVL**（基尔霍夫电压定律）。

cards.title: 接上 LED，量一量
text: 把 LED 和回到 GND 的跳线接上，然后用万用表分别量 R1、R2、LED 两端的电压。

cards.title: 带走
text: - 串联：**电流处处相同**，**电阻相加**，**电压按比例分**。
- 用两个电阻串联，可以凑出手边没有的阻值：220 Ω + 220 Ω = 440 Ω。
- 串联电路的缺点：一个元件断了，整条路都断——老式圣诞灯串一颗坏了全串都灭，就是这个原因。

en.title: Series: one path only
en.summary: Two resistors end to end: the current has only one way to go, and the voltage is shared between them.
en.description: Series means parts joined end to end with a single current path: every part carries the same current, the total resistance is the sum, and the supply voltage is shared in proportion to the resistances. Circuit: 9 V → R1 (220 Ω) → R2 (220 Ω) → red LED → GND.
steps: **R2** (**`220 Ω`**) in **`c7`** – **`c11`**: its first leg and R1's second leg are both in column 7, end to end.
Take a look: from + to column 11 there is one path with no junction anywhere. That is series. Press Next.
Blue **jumper** **`a14`** → **`tn14`** back to GND. The whole path: + → R1 → R2 → LED → GND.
Press **Check my circuit**, then measure the three voltages with the multimeter (red probe on one end, Shift + click for the black probe on the other) and fill in the questions.
hints: R1's second leg and R2's first leg must share a column, or they are not connected.
Do not connect the middle of a series circuit to a rail: the whole circuit is one single path.
tests: LED on, sensible voltages across both resistors

cards.title: Guess first: more current or less?
text: Place just the supply and two resistors, **end to end**.
Guess: compared with a single 220 Ω, will the LED current with two in a row be bigger, smaller or the same? Keep your guess in mind.

cards.title: One path, one current
text: - **Series = one path.** The current leaves + and has to pass R1, R2 and the LED in turn; there is no side road, so **every part carries the same current**.
- In series the resistances **add**: $R_{eq} = R_1 + R_2$. A longer road is harder to travel, so the current drops.

- The voltage is **shared** in proportion to the resistances: two equal resistors get equal shares. All the parts' voltages add up to exactly the supply voltage — that is **KVL** (Kirchhoff's voltage law).

cards.title: Add the LED and measure
text: Connect the LED and the jumper back to GND, then measure the voltages across R1, R2 and the LED with the multimeter.

cards.title: Take away
text: - Series: **same current everywhere**, **resistances add**, **voltage shared in proportion**.
- Two resistors in series give you values you don't have in the drawer: 220 Ω + 220 Ω = 440 Ω.
- The catch: one broken part breaks the whole path — why one dead bulb used to darken a whole string of old-style fairy lights.

measurements.ask: Voltage across R1 (red probe on the end nearer the supply)
Voltage across R2 (red probe on the end next to R1)
measurements.explain: Same current, same resistance, same voltage.

measurements.ask: Voltage across the LED (red probe on the long lead)
From your three readings: V_R1 + V_R2 + V_LED =
measurements.explain: The three add up to the battery voltage: around this loop, whatever the source raises the parts drop again (KVL).

tests.name: LED 亮，两个电阻上的电压合理

measurements.ask: R1 两端的电压（红表笔在靠电源的一端）
R2 两端的电压（红表笔在靠 R1 的一端）
measurements.explain: 同一个电流、同样的电阻，电压也一样。

measurements.ask: LED 两端的电压（红表笔在长脚）
用你的三个读数算：V_R1 + V_R2 + V_LED =
measurements.explain: 三段加起来就是电池电压：沿着这一圈，电源抬高多少，元件就降下多少（KVL）。

steps.text: **R2**（**`220 Ω`**）插 **`c7`** – **`c11`**：它的第一只脚和 R1 的第二只脚都在第 7 列，首尾相接。
看一眼：从 + 到第 11 列只有一条路，中间没有任何岔口。这就是串联。点「下一步」。
蓝色**跳线** **`a14`** → **`tn14`** 回到 GND。整条路：+ → R1 → R2 → LED → GND。
点**「检查我的电路」**，然后用万用表（红表笔一端，Shift + 单击放黑表笔另一端）量三段电压，填进测量题。

hints: R1 的第二只脚和 R2 的第一只脚必须在同一列，否则它们没有连上。
串联电路中间不要接到电源轨上：整个电路只有一条路径。
